   - The error handling in the `cqspi_setup_flash` function has been improved.
   - The line that previously checked for the return value of `of_property_read_u32` was modified to store the return value in the variable `ret`.
   - If `of_property_read_u32` fails, it now correctly sets the error code and jumps to the error handling section.
   - An additional error check was added to handle the case where the chip select (`cs`) is out of range, setting `ret` to `-EINVAL` before logging the error message.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modifications in the `cadence-quadspi.c` file are related to improving error handling in the `cqspi_setup_flash` function. The changes ensure that proper error codes are returned instead of uninitialized values or success indicators when errors occur during the reading of the chip select property and when the chip select value is out of range. This enhances the robustness of the driver by providing clearer feedback on failure conditions.
